about: Kirkland is a city on Montreal’s West Island in Quebec, a suburban municipality of family neighbourhoods, parks, and commercial strips along Highway 40. It sits among other on-island West Island cities such as Pointe-Claire and Dollard-des-Ormeaux, with strong commuting ties into central Montreal. About 20,000 people live in Kirkland.
